lines.text: An hour into a cold drizzle, Dan started tripping on roots, mumbling his words and fumbling with his zipper.
He kept saying he was fine.
Learn the umbles: stumbles, mumbles, fumbles and grumbles.
They can be early signs of hypothermia.
Stop, get out of the wind, swap wet layers for dry ones, add a hat, and turn back together.
If he doesn't improve, call for help.
Save this before your next cold hike.
